transcript:
The Data Workers' Inquiry is a global, participatory research initiative that empowers data labelers, content moderators, and digital platform workers to investigate and document the hidden, precarious labor behind artificial intelligence.

Core Purpose & Methodology

• Worker-Led Inquiry: Modeled after Karl Marx's 1880 Workers' Inquiry, the project uses Workers' Inquiry as a Research Methodology (WIRM).
• Epistemic Authority: Data workers act as lead community researchers rather than passive subjects, shaping their own questions and findings.
• Diverse Outputs: Findings are shared through self-directed formats such as zines, documentaries, comics, essays, podcasts, animations, and research reports.

Key Focus Areas & Issues

• Global Scope: Involves co-researchers and data workers across countries including Kenya, Venezuela, Syria, Brazil, France, Germany, Spain, Lebanon, and the UK.
• Working Conditions: Exposes systemic issues like low pay (sometimes under $1–$2 an hour), sudden platform shutdowns (such as Remotasks in Kenya), severe psychological trauma from content moderation, restrictive non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), and vague task-rejection policies.
• Data Extraction: Highlights how workers are forced to hand over sensitive personal data (such as voice recordings, facial scans, and photos of family members) with little transparency or consent.

Key Partners & Organizing

• Institutions: Spearheaded by researchers including Dr. Milagros Miceli, alongside the Distributed AI Research Institute (DAIR), the Weizenbaum Institute, and TU Berlin.
• Collective Action: Supports worker-led organizing efforts, including groups like the Data Labelers Association in Kenya and the African Content Moderators Union.

The Fairwork Cloudwork Ratings are published by the [Fairwork Project](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESSgHrOzAVpdXapu80-WblepoBY_Xm0bCZYdRIv0Mu3FJIWlstqpIukANd87TvFVsrhGqQmc1oRPhYeWw-s6ysNznjGIPltjbyRWFB) (spun out of the Oxford Internet Institute and the Berlin Social Science Center WZB). They evaluate online remote digital labor platforms (cloudwork) across five core principles of fairness: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESqwEB6zswFSE2USaGHfykY5UHUz5nSPktY1mMfFiyzIqy5ovf_4cMsQ1W7tyk56Q9vR_jMyRvHNQ9mrE8uYtyDzlU-8RfRsO9aqVv4lF8TEaAoTaSulil2jPRL-hFARicqEIx5nVH-noqpEqDbBvl1r7caNcyi6LRgd5HUGg3cUTPDMS1XgOYjA8k1p8-ogVkY9klm0NGFg78L8NLk7YfT0TQ6gs0u36_RXS1txY), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESSgHrOzAVpdXapu80-WblepoBY_Xm0bCZYdRIv0Mu3FJIWlstqpIukANd87TvFVsrhGqQmc1oRPhYeWw-s6ysNznjGIPltjbyRWFB), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESogEB6zswFdzMt4lTM8OMTfHq-TTH3W62_SujXv-W34BAZ8NimUdxWldIf5BzGWGWBsHdRYKpdVG3rdMHIhYKJ9MDBOKT2cJ4HBHCXU4M76TIwY25EPI4Cx84CQDUtW9LVzq8cKCd9zZO6AY5F5Efqknmy5YbUoi8niUMR4tyrjQWHT-jQgn4w6JQ2wlKvsOPtYnv3Uj3LmjX5u7m3eD7MLs_AJw)]

* Fair Pay: Ensuring workers earn a wage proportional to local or national minimum standards after costs.
* Fair Conditions: Protecting workers from digital hazards, health risks (e.g., burnout, back pain), and unsafe environments.
* Fair Contracts: Providing clear, transparent terms without blanket liability clauses or vague job descriptions.
* Fair Management: Offering due process, grievance channels, freedom from arbitrary deactivation, and anti-discrimination measures.
* Fair Representation: Recognizing and engaging with workers' collective voice, freedom of association, and potential for collective bargaining. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVWyseHcrOgeLYqeuVaciIbT2Bl2gheegz8O49fNCFxbxYdR5T7ur7dv2HNN_kFwj7pw73hWUnh9o4u5T3fXX1phCrChePJl7YO6f9pl7sQaeX5KLnBxSyuitR0c4RqA), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHrOzAVmT_5Cq28BhzXXpWWhw_NsRR2M1YeqnnaJ63ypIhP5p_TYGYEzHEc_LXvWbJOtW7j2k__TFM9OfJ6YMz6bqUASor1yExM9Et87zeyspdWRDF4kg81g9jcCZiBAiGY7VN8KsRgoT0tby5-10-bUUFS0CsiqZESvYBT), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESogEB6zswFdzMt4lTM8OMTfHq-TTH3W62_SujXv-W34BAZ8NimUdxWldIf5BzGWGWBsHdRYKpdVG3rdMHIhYKJ9MDBOKT2cJ4HBHCXU4M76TIwY25EPI4Cx84CQDUtW9LVzq8cKCd9zZO6AY5F5Efqknmy5YbUoi8niUMR4tyrjQWHT-jQgn4w6JQ2wlKvsOPtYnv3Uj3LmjX5u7m3eD7MLs_AJw)]

Key Findings from Recent Reports

* Scoring Scale: Platforms are scored out of 10 points based on concrete evidence provided for each threshold. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVrtHczA8RUvhA5UzIvhfYJVNZcQzQH4v1nc9xIpI4hwqMR2y530awmU5yXnsPbAenu5LsgMVJRoiR5LectlKp69zDDWMTAUCN1Q6K55iZUihRcO2VOJf65ngLwPLSmQ), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESogEB6zswFdzMt4lTM8OMTfHq-TTH3W62_SujXv-W34BAZ8NimUdxWldIf5BzGWGWBsHdRYKpdVG3rdMHIhYKJ9MDBOKT2cJ4HBHCXU4M76TIwY25EPI4Cx84CQDUtW9LVzq8cKCd9zZO6AY5F5Efqknmy5YbUoi8niUMR4tyrjQWHT-jQgn4w6JQ2wlKvsOPtYnv3Uj3LmjX5u7m3eD7MLs_AJw)]
* General Trend: Most remote and freelance cloudwork platforms struggle to meet basic fairness standards, though recent reports (such as the 2025 assessment covering 16 platforms) show incremental improvements in areas like formal recognition of the right to organize. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHrOzAVmT_5Cq28BhzXXpWWhw_NsRR2M1YeqnnaJ63ypIhP5p_TYGYEzHEc_LXvWbJOtW7j2k__TFM9OfJ6YMz6bqUASor1yExM9Et87zeyspdWRDF4kg81g9jcCZiBAiGY7VN8KsRgoT0tby5-10-bUUFS0CsiqZESvYBT), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESogEB6zswFdzMt4lTM8OMTfHq-TTH3W62_SujXv-W34BAZ8NimUdxWldIf5BzGWGWBsHdRYKpdVG3rdMHIhYKJ9MDBOKT2cJ4HBHCXU4M76TIwY25EPI4Cx84CQDUtW9LVzq8cKCd9zZO6AY5F5Efqknmy5YbUoi8niUMR4tyrjQWHT-jQgn4w6JQ2wlKvsOPtYnv3Uj3LmjX5u7m3eD7MLs_AJw)]
* Global Disparities: Workers in the Global South often face steeper challenges, lower effective compensation relative to local costs of living, and higher rates of unaddressed discrimination. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVWyseHcrOgeLYqeuVaciIbT2Bl2gheegz8O49fNCFxbxYdR5T7ur7dv2HNN_kFwj7pw73hWUnh9o4u5T3fXX1phCrChePJl7YO6f9pl7sQaeX5KLnBxSyuitR0c4RqA)]

You can read the full breakdown and platform scorecards on the [Fairwork Cloudwork Ratings Page](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESawHrOzAVXbgLBpcTcS59Pb0TSfgk1Hcmn7jysid1ayaa9YNIbSSuQ5yXGJ_ThmxPeimEAs5k6BHBIK1azu6t0gvH7o0YKkEUc7gX0CGS1tJNCCG0PGqOOmU0XS6OqpIyXyv1huk-PRq0xkDP). The Partnership on AI (PAI) focuses on responsible sourcing through its workstream on Responsible Sourcing Across the Data Supply Line, which aims to improve working conditions, fair pay, and well-being for global data enrichment and annotation professionals. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHrOzAVhLF-HqgyDY2ibtzMNR6ewH3hO-GJaMf6TQcxxCokUAEnG5rOTKamVs1FUFLMD2zRY-hsMH0zOEim1Hhq4fw3A7YqViOWDQqJ3WkrI9LlpC9qGzki6dLesQYaJD7dxbg6Nzm1C7OX0UN0pFB9Eitq), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFcijssYIixxqPeJWFKr06zM6Te2Yt-2Z8S9-QcFLUHLrBEuNgxhlS6isT00BEgbv_OLO2N4zVHKabTyTw-lDrVD2rSLWoHgFbjYxqIOOLh_Qn7xbqmXPt5Ri9yPw-UP_bAaxy4dzPknOu0YbNvMq19YeIkTBo6zs8fbN2xyMp4DU)]
Key Frameworks and Resources

* Responsible Sourcing of Data Enrichment Services: A foundational white paper published by PAI that examines how procurement choices impact data workers and outlines industry practices to build an ethical supply chain. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAVND9eFZCGixAz3bZoO8wN8T9qrb8BmKoRzy6IulvThWyTeBETsd2J4trGMIMtbg7zYS6Y9Ja767PdiEnxPaiDR3LxVVdHsUQEgYaInf2y_RBzgujcY0fGZabmBhU5kr4hA_KEYCr1cRv9zBsjhvR2DsT46Q), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHrOzAVFmcQ-XobG4Ddo1Uwj9nuP6v50MoC0NJZZFNYIvJmN87T4gwUvKcPdV4wKToiekCSVzQDwDw_d3pz-0lYs3A7VflUuRtetPoetJTTR9bDy_PTeCPMQIsOAxV01gMmENlmct6cACPKgIVF)]
* Vendor Engagement Guidance: Practical tools to help AI developers have more accountable conversations with downstream vendors regarding worker treatment and contract terms. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFcijssYIixxqPeJWFKr06zM6Te2Yt-2Z8S9-QcFLUHLrBEuNgxhlS6isT00BEgbv_OLO2N4zVHKabTyTw-lDrVD2rSLWoHgFbjYxqIOOLh_Qn7xbqmXPt5Ri9yPw-UP_bAaxy4dzPknOu0YbNvMq19YeIkTBo6zs8fbN2xyMp4DU)]
* Transparency Template: A standard outlining what companies should actively monitor and publicly report about their data enrichment operations. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEB6zswFcijssYIixxqPeJWFKr06zM6Te2Yt-2Z8S9-QcFLUHLrBEuNgxhlS6isT00BEgbv_OLO2N4zVHKabTyTw-lDrVD2rSLWoHgFbjYxqIOOLh_Qn7xbqmXPt5Ri9yPw-UP_bAaxy4dzPknOu0YbNvMq19YeIkTBo6zs8fbN2xyMp4DU)]
* Data Enrichment Sourcing Guidelines & Checklists: Shareable resources—including the Good Instructions Checklist and vendor comparison templates—designed to operationalize worker-centric standards. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEB6zswFcmZkTtYbzCA9zH2osAMKR_j-Iiu7d_b9Ld_CkffQco1ST2-pKSq3yfrGCDoha4HKXRnFsbr3cXXh8gKD5z6nyCEgS_rnLA76ossU_DbJBHd2Z9ihpoQ3E8L6ONaZyCdO9jR-qwBXba1PTsjr_q6APTT8ZmH1jKDdTU8XiKBr7cbBuRllyOjRFw1mmq55pGQKaJoofkeIns9OxzvcCt1VK4)]

Real-World Implementation

* DeepMind Collaboration: PAI partnered with Google DeepMind to test and put these responsible sourcing recommendations into operational practice, sharing lessons learned to help other AI organizations raise standards across the industry. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHrOzAVZ9hzdvGoFuVTV7gTFhG86AR5uDnJY3wi5ilH7QV-n2R6X5vrF8RH-diU5rt4dkK6Mzo28ei88Z-zL_u0CXLpckNCfr7hchlZONkKRgnye3L1rh8dC04pymqKlQnxaHpCbolMyrkd4gwwfMkmbU_9ssJQaw), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVjwkAM8M4WzQceYJFLyQmDpVCSyxnUdjvcvXXHA97v_BWieBiHfslPU-1kbHVTFE5TyPZNlvbxD7iznnDk89tONIy_aEaNJaSCHgPG24Ich5w5V7Blcng2dU9EDkrFQ)]

Six Silberman. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHrOzAVqq1WFLpLReRl9n8JZ5pcCcjHpdDZlA-0QuRW43GkQZilUdW1DayU-mnlfSOE0zvXUWOo10AiAgl13jaJOA4wiWFjeBkD-Ky1tstK), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHrOzAV5mx580UBbNiSU7Jr2je5033j2hvXAvZdqmOml69uWkzdGP1tI-mDN-LNP19ds7dF71aDFPHdQBdhV-83KykJOoG_rXh9sHyJ_bIlywYw5MXcrMKoDagqUZE0nlzrGLvFygDh5hOFnpRFy9Vs3ic), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHrOzAVWbzBKUrhumr_VESAdYqAZXJxhM6zbtohUMcO83SM6sKLl3UcQQdm2f3OTwbhim7G_JqxVwWRnldEWq0b-Ynfl883tDeQW8QI7b_ra1AlJMGXnSos1xjEaDTbaA_JuYelxXab)]
Core Purpose & Function

* Platform Review Tool: Originally launched as a browser extension and website for Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) crowdworkers, it lets workers review and rate employers ("requesters") on metrics like pay, fairness, speed, and communication. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEB6zswFeQWxj2LPWz4rqWFTD-7EJHnhJTRiGrU3jQYvKpnMVUYklvDzrunCh6FtIrpX-0bUu94qtn6Wtm_om69v1S6v7EIu0otPxsUpK3Wi6Ri8Zc5yXAsQNjzdpQFmBTguWxCy80qtWJ0NRGsHVciUEAkfp7v51WN-Y6Rox-xkGg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHrOzAV5mx580UBbNiSU7Jr2je5033j2hvXAvZdqmOml69uWkzdGP1tI-mDN-LNP19ds7dF71aDFPHdQBdhV-83KykJOoG_rXh9sHyJ_bIlywYw5MXcrMKoDagqUZE0nlzrGLvFygDh5hOFnpRFy9Vs3ic)]
* Combating Invisibility: The tool helps make worker-employer relations transparent, helping users avoid unfair rejections, wage theft, and exploitative tasks. [Worker Info Exchange](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVxRYcpWW_pTvkk5p8DO9aLA01JzD92pcYSHIRv7MIGw03fKpni86xB34cZTGV7czjFK66TgO5upsvqtoYZeX1F29t89VaCZW78X8ww-y22VAsMiUcAJI) is a non-profit organization based in London (operating also as Stichting WIE International) that fights for the digital and labor rights of gig economy workers. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVxRYcpWW_pTvkk5p8DO9aLA01JzD92pcYSHIRv7MIGw03fKpni86xB34cZTGV7czjFK66TgO5upsvqtoYZeX1F29t89VaCZW78X8ww-y22VAsMiUcAJI), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHrOzAVDWF1xryrobc8zKIHIlUAyKOBdxRzHp9-V5imS6Z5bSq0jMYw6DQlXYssonIo_NO9TH9gq3F1GhEmHkaJWKdVE5aszx47Oi-GyWyPEvtH35rh)]
Key Mission & Work

* Data Control: Helps gig workers use data access and Subject Access Requests (SARs) to see how tech platforms track pay, work allocation, and performance. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVxRYcpWW_pTvkk5p8DO9aLA01JzD92pcYSHIRv7MIGw03fKpni86xB34cZTGV7czjFK66TgO5upsvqtoYZeX1F29t89VaCZW78X8ww-y22VAsMiUcAJI)]
* Algorithmic Accountability: Investigates and challenges unfair management practices, automated dismissals, and dynamic pricing or pay systems. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHrOzAVDWF1xryrobc8zKIHIlUAyKOBdxRzHp9-V5imS6Z5bSq0jMYw6DQlXYssonIo_NO9TH9gq3F1GhEmHkaJWKdVE5aszx47Oi-GyWyPEvtH35rh), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVxRYcpWW_pTvkk5p8DO9aLA01JzD92pcYSHIRv7MIGw03fKpni86xB34cZTGV7czjFK66TgO5upsvqtoYZeX1F29t89VaCZW78X8ww-y22VAsMiUcAJI)]
* Collective Legal Action: Coordinates group lawsuits against major platforms like Uber—such as collective claims challenging dynamic pay systems that reduce driver earnings and increase hidden commissions. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWwHrOzAVxRYcpWW_pTvkk5p8DO9aLA01JzD92pcYSHIRv7MIGw03fKpni86xB34cZTGV7czjFK66TgO5upsvqtoYZeX1F29t89VaCZW78X8ww-y22VAsMiUcAJI), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVgHrOzAVDWF1xryrobc8zKIHIlUAyKOBdxRzHp9-V5imS6Z5bSq0jMYw6DQlXYssonIo_NO9TH9gq3F1GhEmHkaJWKdVE5aszx47Oi-GyWyPEvtH35rh)]
* Research & Alliances: Partners with academic institutions like the University of Oxford and labor bodies (such as the TUC) to publish landmark research exposing the real-world impact of platform algorithms on workers. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESwQEB6zswFQsmgbt9DMIzhJq4jpinZFNA6LbrdTKGK1uIHzsa_Fd-mbEsC9i6pSI_7Gv4X5BeWh5Ntr0dN6xNxOw9xrQzmnld5iZDaNOZEbMjUjMLtd4HA5i_D1EYBZndiEjVhmHf0dndxu6t0wBajZfnXCK2749tnBhGGuL-B9Ycp5LVY11SSthaxM2ryKHZqI9CCj9xREQQ8B3DFrOWyo08l_1V6E0OVWBFev0l5pqLcx5QvDZZ8tAJ_D2T8pgdnr2I), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESxwEB6zswFYqhrosFrttu6V8VaxmMyTSUBFKLRd1VOZwE-Noza5d7afdLwzlo2ifB6bk0zVGDAlZcrY3S6s2KOkDwhgqYOKe_CxurZl_w9dTGL5g6MLhysTHwCt_8SkoHrQR8Z7iQxig1p01x-BY_0DgieA7uXTazzXOKaqFiWm6qBqE64Rm8M8OBfAgdZacZeg5hoaFUyoNiboFtPX_EQ7XEquztFV_sPjTiBKYTFyWrPlo7XWo-H7BQYSAqUW7qtJFyEabsq-al)]
